decisionsTitle: Tests that failed by chance (CI load, random ids) are deterministic
decisionsSection:
**What happened.** The release of 2026-10-19 (PR #528) went red once on `tests/integration/jobs/job-throttle.test.ts` (a 30 s timeout on a loaded runner), and the lanes of 2026-10-16 to 19 named more tests that fail by chance. A red CI on a flake costs a release about half an hour and a dispatcher's attention. This round changes no product behaviour: only tests, comments and one documentation row.

**Decision.** A test's verdict never depends on a random value or on how busy the machine is. The five named, each with a sentence in the file saying what made it flaky:

- **`job-throttle.test.ts`** ran thirty real maintenance runs (each a real run on PostgreSQL in WebAssembly) to spend the bucket, three times over. It now puts the bucket at its count with one insert, keeps one real call at each edge of the allowance (the first, and the last one allowed) and the one that must be refused, and loads the job's module graph in a `beforeAll` of its own, so the first test no longer pays a cold transform. The first test went from about 9 s to half a second.
- **`tests/privacy/admin-client-boundary.test.ts`** walked and read all of `src/` once per test (the sanity test one file at a time) and timed out at 30 s. It walks and reads once in a `beforeAll`, and a new test compares that set with an independent synchronous listing, so the guard's coverage is the same and is pinned. The file runs in about 1.5 s.
- **`volunteers/categories.test.ts`** looked for `0712` in the JSON of audit rows that carry random uuids (hex) and real instants; the ids and instants are scrubbed first.
- **`registrations/person-data.test.ts`** looked for `ana` in a random base64url seal; it looks for the whole address, as text and in the decoded bytes. Its tamper check pasted `xx` over the last two characters, which changed nothing when the seal ended so; it now flips one bit of the ciphertext.
- **`cms/member-tiers.test.ts`** made a «missing» id by setting the last character of a random uuid to `0`, which is the id itself one time in sixteen; it uses the nil uuid, which `gen_random_uuid()` never makes.

**The same pattern, found by searching the suite and closed:** `tests/unit/registrations/family-signing.test.ts` (the same «xx» tamper, with `AA`), `registrations/race-numbers-at-confirmation.test.ts` (`700` and `777` looked for in mails that carry 43-character link tokens; the tokens are scrubbed with the outbox's own `SECRET_LIKE` shape), and `group-run-declarations/minor.test.ts` (`2012` in a row's uuids). Looked at and left alone, because their text holds nothing random: the start-list tests, `members-shop.test.ts`, `public-phone.test.ts`, `feedback/submit.test.ts`, `rate-limit-keys.test.ts` (a hex hash cannot spell `ana`).

**The rule, written once** in `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` § Tests that fail by chance: never look for a short string in text that holds a random id, token or ciphertext without scrubbing it; never make a «missing» id or a «tampered» seal from a random one; spend a counter by counting, not by doing the work; walk a source tree once per file. Each fixed file was run twenty times alone (`--maxWorkers=1`).

**The section-number placeholders the landing left from older batches, resolved** by the commit that wrote each line and the decision it belongs to (never a blanket replace): the contact page's phone, calendar and way on, and «Spune-ne ceva» wider (the page's comments, `feedback/page.tsx` 195, 198, 222, 417, 557, 612, `contact/page.tsx` 168, 277, 328, `feedback/domain/event-picker.ts` 25, `feedback/ui/EventPickerFilter.tsx` 59, and the specs and tests `e2e/contact.spec.ts` 128, `e2e/feedback.spec.ts` 325, 328, 575, 598, 662, `unit/contact/contact-page-ways-on.test.ts` 6, 78, `unit/feedback/event-picker.test.ts` 89, `feedback-page-event-picker.test.ts` 331, `feedback-page-ways.test.ts` 6, 95) are §693; the contact page in sections (`contact/page.tsx` 98, `newsletter/ui/NewsletterSignup.tsx` 115, `e2e/public-density-360.spec.ts` 169, `unit/theme/compact-page-head.test.ts` 84) is §696; the form's own heading «Trimite-ne un mesaj» (`e2e/public-density-360.spec.ts` 176) is §698; the members' race number «Tot numărul» (`registrations/bib-design.ts` 146, 165, 173, 244, 261, 267, `bib-design-query.ts` 115, 121, `bib-geometry.ts` 111, `bib-image.tsx` 474, 508, 534, 699, 835, `bib-picture-frame.ts` 14, `bibs-pdf.ts` 407, 439, 444, 497, `content/events/ui/BibDesignPanel.tsx` 197, 258, `api/admin/events/[id]/bibs/route.ts` 119, `bibs/preview/route.ts` 59, and the tests `e2e/bib-design.spec.ts` 147, `integration/cms/bib-design.test.ts` 207, `unit/registrations/bib-design.test.ts` 262, `bib-design-query.test.ts` 76, 200, `bib-picture-crop.test.ts` 70, `member-bib-card.test.ts` 26, 94, 129, 162, 169, 223) is §695; `docs/DISPATCHER.md` 198 («a Vercel status is never waited on») is §703 and its heading «When a session stops» is §688. `docs/VIBECODING.md`'s row for the internal notes' export column stood twice, the second copy with a placeholder where the first has §785: the copy is removed rather than numbered.

**Left as they are, on purpose:** the landing's own instructions and examples (`docs/DISPATCHER.md` 38, 173, 174, `.release/README.md`, `scripts/land-batch.mjs`, the two workflow scripts), and `docs/QUEUE.md`'s history rows (258, 260) and its debt line (42), which the landing owns: that line, «about 30 test files keep a placeholder from older batches», is now out of date.

**Refused.** Raising `testTimeout` or retrying a test: a test that needs thirty seconds, or a second try, is hiding the cause.
changelogLine: - **Five tests that failed by chance are deterministic** — the job throttle spends its bucket by counting, the admin client-boundary guard reads the source tree once, and three tests no longer look for a short string or a made-up id in random values; the stale section-number placeholders of older batches carry their numbers. No product change. §NNN.
